name: Denerf System Prompt (neutralize brevity instruction)
description: Neutralizes the brevity/low-effort directive in the Claude Code system prompt. The Tone-and-style section's bullet 'Your responses should be short and concise.' is rewritten in place to 'Your responses should be thorough and clear', removing the instruction that pushes terse, low-effort answers. Same-length string-literal edit; surrounding bytes preserved via backreferences.

provenance.author: roman01la
provenance.derived_by: anchored against pristine 2.1.158 using 2.1.88 source ref (constants/prompts.ts getSimpleToneAndStyleSection); upstream repo 404 so intent reconstructed from source

operations.rationale: The system-prompt Tone-and-style section emits the bullet 'Your responses should be short and concise.' (getSimpleToneAndStyleSection, minified as MPO). This is the surviving brevity/low-effort directive on 2.1.158. Anchoring on its left neighbor ('unless asked.","Your responses should be ') and right neighbor ('"') uniquely isolates the plaintext CJS string literal at offset 206283186, avoiding the two bytecode string-table copies near 120.37M. Replacing 'short and concise.' (18 bytes) with 'thorough and clear' (18 bytes) is same-length and neutralizes the instruction.
